augur-description: One of the first decentralized prediction market protocols, launched on Ethereum in 2018. Activity has been limited since 2021, and a reboot is underway. You'll need some technical expertise to use it.
kalshi-description: A U.S. exchange regulated by the CFTC. You can deposit USDC from Ethereum or Base, but trading and settlement happen on Kalshi's own systems, not onchain.
polymarket-description: One of the largest prediction markets. Trades settle on Polygon, and results are decided through the UMA oracle. Not available in every country.
